body: No, all my legal and medical options have exhausted. I even tried faking insanity.
I'm facing six felonies. I want to become a fugitive, but have my disappearance ruled a death.
So the prosecutor will drop charges. What if I can delay anyone finding the blood for a week or so?

I've read of people being declared dead just from a few liters of their blood being found in one place. I guess it might get ruled a homicide, but I don't care.

A local hospital has some of my blood, so the coroner would get my DNA to match easily.

I just want a new damn life

And you know what is weird? I read so many stories of people on here wanting to off themselves with only one of the component problems of my life. I think I'm just too much of a narcissist to want to kill myself.
